item.text: {"summary":"Draft is publishable after tightening the update arithmetic: resolver, unit, source, first-print handling, interval, tails, and JSON fields are mostly coherent, but part of the point adjustment is under-justified.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +0.015 residual annual participation growth and especially the +0.006 rounding/model blend are not tied to a clear historical calculation or evidence source.","actionRequested":"Replace these with explicit calculations from the cited FY/monthly history, or remove/rename them so the point estimate follows directly from the stated persistence and seasonality adjustments."},{"rubricItem":"prior_update_interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The compact prior/update/interval step is close, but the adjustment components include one arbitrary blend term and do not clearly separate prior, seasonal adjustment, trend adjustment, and judgmental residual.","actionRequested":"Revise the math sentence to name each adjustment with its empirical basis and make the final 6.790 calculation reproducible without an unexplained plug term."}],"optionalSuggestions":["State that the latest available same-series observation is 2025-11 as of the run, to make the no-leakage boundary explicit.","If the FNS release calendar has a named May 2026 WIC release entry, cite that entry wording in the resolver paragraph rather than only saying it was checked."]}
